assets.description: One call of a black-throated loon (Gavia arctica), trimmed from XC803905 (0.90 s, from 14.05 s to 14.95 s of the source), mixed to mono, resampled to 22050 Hz, peak-normalised to -1 dBFS, 20 ms fades at both ends. No other processing.
assets.sourceDetail: Recorded 2023-05-19 at Leksand Municipality, Dalarnas län, Sweden, by Grégoire Chauvot. Quality A, song, male, field recording, no playback used. Source download is a 122.4 s 48 kHz stereo WAV, sha1 74804ef4ce7e408d7e1c7eca5135e32d1f915ff4. This clip: sha1 1bd7e94ac2174da5aa643c420a50d6c118986c6b.
